create.name: Gary Kraftsow
create.bio:
For more than forty years Gary Kraftsow, an American yoga teacher, has taught in the Viniyoga tradition. In 1974 he began studying with T.K.V. Desikachar in India, and in 1988, in Paris, he received a Viniyoga Special Diploma. He also holds a master's in psychology and religion from UC Santa Barbara. In the early 1980s he opened a school of yoga therapy on Maui, and he still directs the American Viniyoga Institute, which he set up in 1999. He helped to design the yoga protocols for two research studies run by the National Institutes of Health and for a trial of workplace stress reduction.

In his teaching, breath-centred āsana is joined with prāṇāyāma, chanting, mantra and meditation, all adapted to the individual, together with the philosophy of the Yoga Sūtras, Sāṁkhya and Tantra. At the institute he leads the Viniyoga Foundations Program and therapist training, and he also offers an online library of live and recorded classes, plus workshops and retreats in the US and abroad. Penguin is the publisher of both Yoga for Transformation and Yoga for Wellness, his two books, and he teaches several self-paced courses on The Shift Network.

books.title: Yoga for Wellness: Healing with the Timeless Teachings of Viniyoga
books.author: Gary Kraftsow
books.description: An illustrated, step-by-step guide to the Viniyoga approach, in which postures, breathing and sequences are adapted to the individual. It explains how to build a personal practice that brings together the physical and spiritual sides of yoga.

books.title: Yoga for Transformation: Ancient Teachings and Practices for Healing the Body, Mind, and Heart
books.author: Gary Kraftsow
books.description: Looks beyond yoga as exercise to its work with the emotions, mind, heart and spirit. With more than 350 photographs, it offers breathing practices to regulate energy, exercises to sharpen the intellect and meditations for self-awareness.

courses.title: Antya Krama — Yogic Practices to Prepare for Sacred Transition
courses.description: A 12-module self-paced course that applies āsana, prāṇāyāma, chanting, mantra and meditation to each of the cakras in turn. Drawn from the Antya Krama tradition, it is a way of working with attachments and repeating patterns and of preparing inwardly for life's final transition.

courses.title: AVI Online Digital Library (Ananta Pass)
courses.description: A membership library of more than 200 recorded and live Viniyoga classes with Gary Kraftsow and the institute's teachers, covering daily practice, prāṇāyāma, kriyās, bandhas and Sāṁkhya philosophy. The full pass includes a monthly mentorship meeting with Gary.

courses.title: Viniyoga Foundations Program for Teaching and Yoga Therapy
courses.description: The institute's 300- or 500-hour training, led by Gary Kraftsow, combining virtual weekends with week-long in-person intensives. It covers personal practice, āsana, prāṇāyāma, chanting, meditation, tantra, teaching method and yoga philosophy, and is the first part of the Viniyoga therapist certification.

courses.title: Dharma and Svadharma: Creating an Auspicious Life
courses.description: A three-hour online workshop, hosted by Yogacampus in London, on aligning everyday action with one's svadharma. It covers the Puruṣārthas, the three karmas, the stages of life and personal practice, with a presentation and integrated practice.

courses.title: Darśanam: Renewing Your Inner Practice
courses.description: A programme of satsangs and workshops at the Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat in the Bahamas exploring the Vedanta schools of dualism, qualified non-dualism and non-dualism. The teachings are used as practical frames for self-inquiry, meditation and daily life.

courses.title: Āsana Unlocked: Reframe Your Understanding, Renew Your Practice, Refresh Your Teaching
courses.description: A digital course of more than 13 hours with five full practices introducing the Viniyoga approach to postures. It covers coordinating breath and movement, adapting form to the individual, repetition and stay, and the craft of sequencing.

courses.title: Meditation Unlocked
courses.description: A 10-hour digital course with seven integrated practices combining āsana, prāṇāyāma, chanting and meditation. It looks at meditation as a way to deepen self-understanding, meet change and find purpose.

free_resources.title: Viniyoga Free Samples
free_resources.description: Short audio extracts from Gary Kraftsow's lectures on the Yoga Sūtras, Viniyoga fundamentals and the role of the breath in practice. A simple way to hear how he teaches before joining a class.

His social accounts are the American Viniyoga Institute's (his school), not personal ones.

Only one photo confirmed (Shift Network headshot, 300 px); the YouTube avatar is the institute logo at 92 px and the site's other picture is a wide banner.
Book title 'Yoga for Wellness: Healing with...' kept: subtitle says healing but names no condition; the full Amazon blurb couldn't be read.
